provenance.excerpt: approved FCDO contribution is GBP 1,240,000

conflicts.annotation: The award letter and indicator data spreadsheet both record the total programme budget as GBP 1,240,000. The amended budget schedule records GBP 1,184,000 as the 'approved budget (contract)'. This may indicate a formal budget amendment reducing the contract value by GBP 56,000. Notably, 1,184,000 also appears as the actual spend figure in the indicator data spreadsheet (Financials!D2), which may be coincidental or may indicate the amended budget equals cumulative spend. Gate-1 review should confirm whether a formal variation was executed and which figure represents the current contracted amount.
